title: Monitor: delete of a file over the 8 MiB live limit, and a 2000-entry listing compressed in a table item
description: Two limits to watch, not yet a defect: deleting a file larger than the 8 MiB live limit, and a listing of 2000 entries compressed into a DynamoDB table item (400 KB item limit). Add a metric or alarm, or a scenario at the boundary, and revisit if real use approaches either.
right_now_summary: The team is watching the 8 MiB delete limit and 2,000-entry compressed listing for real-world use.
